name: (04) Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos) — 2 Intermediate — Fear-Plague

system.description: Draws out a victim's deepest fears and turns them into haunting, recurring omens that follow him everywhere. Spend a Willpower Trait and defeat him in a Mental Challenge; for one week he cannot spend Willpower Traits for any purpose besides serving his Nature or his immediate survival.
